Create a subject-aware map family

Source: R/map.R
MapFamily.Rd

Create a subject-aware map family

Usage

MapFamily(
  name,
  from_space,
  to_space,
  type = c("linear", "orthogonal", "affine3d", "deform3d", "ot"),
  by_subject,
  traits = list(orthogonal = FALSE, mass_preserving = FALSE),
  uncertainty = UncertaintyRule("independent")
)

Arguments

name

Family name

from_space

Source space

to_space

Target space

type

Map type identifier

by_subject

Named list of per-subject operator descriptors

traits

Map traits

uncertainty

UncertaintyRule

Value

Object of class c("gds_map_family", "gds_map")
